name: Villamena (Spain)
description: White field with three red bends sinister from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged at the upper hoist with the crowned municipal arms of Villamena (a tower and a tree on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Villamena; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
